_readme: Date types (Sam's Date… menu). Add a new key to add a date.

label, cost (gold), energy (Sam's energy it takes), trust / mood (base gains), like (which personality like it counts as: walk, dinner, theater, gift, private, chat, train), restores (her energy +), greedyMood (extra mood for Greedy ladies).
intro + one of lines make the result text ({name} = her name). past: a different version when Sam's backstory matches (cost, trustMult, intro, lines).
image: the date's image scene (comp, setting, snip). It's available as date_<key> in the image menu.
Optional: lewd (lewdness she gains, 0-100 scale, typically 1-4); needsUp (an upgrade id the house must own for the date to appear, e.g. bath).

image may also carry undress ('partial' or 'under': she is shown at most that undressed, within her comfort) and bath (true: a bathing scene; bath-compatible outfits, otherwise towel/undergarments/undressed).

walk.label: Walk through the market
walk.intro: Sam and {name} wander the market stalls.
lines: She haggles a merchant down to half price just to show off.
They split a skewer of something that is definitely not chicken.
She drags him to every single fabric stall.

image.comp: strolling arm in arm through a busy market, laughing
image.setting: colorful fantasy market street with stalls and lanterns

picnic.label: Picnic by the river
picnic.intro: A blanket, a basket, and the river sliding by.
lines: She falls asleep on his shoulder.
They watch the two moons come up early.
A duck steals a sandwich. She laughs until she cries.

image.comp: sitting together on a picnic blanket, sharing food, relaxed
image.setting: grassy riverbank under a willow tree, golden afternoon light

dinner.label: Dinner at the Lark & Kettle
lines: She orders for both of them after watching him squint at the menu.
He tells her about ramen. She makes him promise to recreate it someday.
She laughs so hard at one of his stories that wine comes out of her nose. They agree never to speak of it.

cook.intro: Sam cooks for {name} in the kitchen after closing.
lines: She has thirds.
She tries to get the recipe out of him and fails.
She says it's the best thing she's eaten in this world.

image.comp: sharing a candlelit dinner, leaning toward each other, smiling
image.setting: small cozy fantasy restaurant, warm candlelight

theater.label: A night at the theater
theater.intro: The Hollowmere Players are doing a tragedy.
lines: She cries through the whole third act and denies it afterward.
Sam falls asleep in act two. She pokes him awake, grinning.
She whispers commentary the entire time. It is better than the play.

image.comp: seated side by side in a theater box, watching the stage, her hand on his arm
image.setting: ornate fantasy theater, red velvet seats, stage lights

shopping.label: Shopping (she picks something)
shopping.intro: {name} drags Sam through every boutique in Old Town.
lines: She comes out with a ridiculous hat.
She comes out with a silk scarf.
She comes out with a pair of earrings she "absolutely needed."
She comes out with perfume that smells like rain.

image.comp: holding up a new purchase and showing it off happily
image.setting: elegant fantasy boutique full of fabrics and jewelry

springs.label: Day at the hot springs
springs.intro: A whole day of steam, warm water, and doing nothing.
lines: {name} comes back pink-cheeked and completely relaxed.

image.comp: relaxing together in a steaming outdoor hot spring, flushed and content
image.setting: mountain hot spring among rocks and snow-dusted pines

stargazing.label: Stargazing on the rooftop
stargazing.intro: Sam spreads a blanket on the roof after dark, and the two moons hang low over the city.
lines: She traces the constellations and makes up her own names for them.
She tucks herself against his side when the night wind picks up.
They stay far longer than they meant to, talking quietly until the lanterns below go out.

image.comp: lying together on a blanket, gazing at the night sky, her head on his shoulder
image.setting: rooftop at night under a sky full of stars and two moons, soft lantern glow

festival.label: Street fair and games
festival.intro: The street fair is in town, all bunting, music and noisy game stalls.
lines: She wins a stuffed dragon at the ring toss and refuses to let Sam carry it.
They share candied nuts and gossip about every passerby.
She drags him into the dance circle, and he is terrible. She loves it.

image.comp: laughing together at a game stall, holding a prize and sweets
image.setting: lively fantasy street fair at dusk with bunting, lanterns and game stalls

lake.label: Swim at the hidden lake
lake.intro: Sam knows a lake deep in the woods where nobody ever goes.
lines: She wades in first and splashes him until he follows.
They float on their backs and say nothing for a long while.
She dries off in a sunny patch of grass, completely unbothered by his staring.

image.comp: swimming and playing in the water together, wet hair, laughing
image.setting: secluded forest lake with clear water, sunlight through the trees

soak.label: Late soak in the bathhouse
soak.intro: The last client has gone. Sam and {name} have the bathhouse to themselves.
lines: She sinks into the water with a long sigh and drifts closer without a word.
He scrubs her back. She returns the favor, and takes her time.
They linger until the water cools and the lanterns burn low.

image.comp: soaking together in a steaming bath, relaxed and flushed, close to each other
image.setting: steamy tiled bathhouse after hours, glowing lanterns, warm water

posing.label: Pose for Sam's sketchbook
posing.intro: Sam once took an art class. He is about to find out how much of it stuck.
lines: She holds a pose with great dignity while he scowls at his page.
His drawing looks nothing like her. She frames it anyway.
She critiques his shading, then shifts the pose to see him blush.

image.comp: posing gracefully while Sam sketches her, a sketchbook in his hands
image.setting: cozy sunlit room with an easel, charcoal sketches and drapery
